description: This file defines the InstanceAPI class, a REST controller for handling installation instance data through GET and POST requests in the OrangeHRM installer module.

classes.name: InstanceAPI
classes.description: A REST controller handling API requests related to the installation instance data, including storing and retrieving information such as organization name, country, language, and timezone.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Processes POST requests to store installation instance information after validating required parameters.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Processes GET requests to retrieve stored installation instance information.
